verdict.rationale: Poly stores Markdown notes (journal entries in the Mind folder) and imports from Notion and Obsidian, so block-level transclusion is a fair question for it. However, no evidence describes referencing or embedding a block or section of one note inside another, or keeping such an embed in sync. Search results 'down to the paragraph' and Finder tag sync are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reference or transclude an individual block or section of one note inside another and have it stay in sync
